DeployBot: rc candidate created: rc-2026.03.20-7 for service=inference-runtime image=sha256:8f4a2b... scheduled canary prod-us-east-1 @2026-03-20T22:00Z. Rollback-window=30m. Required: docs stamp + sheriff ack. /links: pipeline/3721, artifacts/sha256:8f4a2b...
Maya: ack — verified staging smoke + kv-warm records look good. no DB migrations. :white_check_mark:
Sanjay: can someone paste the short release-notes blurb for the ops channel? want to include in the handoff doc.
Leah: brief notes posted: https://confluence/redwood/rc-2026-03-20-7 
Leah: notes snippet: "Fix memory leak in KV cache; improve batching heuristics; opt-in quantization toggle for nv4. No schema changes."
Oliver: I'll be on sheriff for the canary window 22:00-22:45 UTC. ping me for immediate rollback. :raised_hand:
Maya: quick smoke checklist I ran: `curl -sS http://staging/infer/health | jq .ok` -> true; sample generation latency <120ms p50. KV warm hit ~78%.
Oncall-Sheriff: copy. I want a pinned prom query for token-error-rate and 95th-latency. Recommend thresholds: token_error_rate >0.5% for 3m OR p95 latency >800ms for 2m -> auto rollback.
Sanjay: added the queries to the dashboard and enabled alert rule draft `rc-canary-guards`. linking: https://telemetry/redwood/d/rc-canary-guards
Maya: rollback playbook (if triggered): ``
# rollback to previous image
kubectl set image deployment/inference-runtime inference-runtime=registry.redwood/release:2026-03-19-15 
# verify pods ready and slice traffic back
``
Leah: also added release notes short text to the release ticket and included the change-window: 22:00-23:00 UTC, quiet window 60m after promotion.
DeployBot: Reminder: pin requested artifact for prod promotion: run `deploybot pin rc-2026.03.20-7 --until 2026-04-03` to avoid accidental rotation.
Oliver: pinned and left a note in the ticket. I'll escalate immediately if alerts fire.
Maya: tagging ops and support: @support-team please standby for post-promo smoke.
Oncall-Sheriff: on standby. If alert fires, I'll hit rollback and post status here. :ok_hand:
DeployBot: canary promotion started at 2026-03-20T22:00:12Z — canary instances 5 -> monitoring.
Maya: initial canary p50 140ms, p95 430ms, token errors 0.02% — looks healthy.
Sanjay: acked, moving to watch window.
Leah: thanks everyone — I'll update the ticket with final promotion notes once we hit quiet window. :slightly_smiling_face:
